headline: Leeds United 1-1 Manchester United: Premier League – as it happened
body: Leeds’ Dominic Calvert-Lewin cancelled out a Bryan Mbeumo opener to end a turbulent week for the visitors ⚽ The Joy of Six: Leeds v Manchester United matches Daniel Farke , Leeds manager, is the next to speak to Sky Sports: We have to make sure we give them nothing. We want to make sure the ball belongs to us, to press them high, to have possession. Continue reading...
